A.name: Scenario A · base case
A.summary: Stock at Reno and the PDC is pooled against every order, a bike can ship the week it is built, and the plan decides builds only.

rows.check: Whole bikes, none negative
Capacity never exceeded; no stock level below zero
No task runs above its run limit
Whole-bike plan within 1 bike of the LP, cumulative, every task
Rounding to whole bikes adds no missed targets
Closure: LP levels = the object's equation run with the LP's decisions
Rollup: pool positions + in transit (+ stock at sites serving no orders) = total net inventory
Shipping projection: nothing negative; on hand − open orders = net inventory
Below target only when the line ran full (or the SKU was at its run limit) every week up to the lead time before
